rows: I have got a better idea. No, wait. I have got one good idea.
Brawling? Yes! No. Yes. Okay, I will show you.
Risk, risk, risk. I like it. Sort of.
Slow? That is brave. I will try.
The people have been great. Let us give them something to scream about.
Quick: I am here. Done. Next.
I want the reaction. The good one, the big one, the one that gets people on their feet.
Look at this. Ready, ready, ready. Okay, I am ready.
Technique, whatever that is! Show me one thing and I will show you a better one.
Strikes are brilliant. Keep your head down and your hands up.
A gamble is a dare. I like dares. Not the dangerous kind, though.
The people want a reaction. They are going to get a good one.
You call me predictable. Right. Watch this. Oh, I just did it again.
Proud of your {strength}? Nice, nice! Nice. Mine is better. Probably.
I have been watching your {strength}. Got a thing in mind for it. Just a small one.
Level! Nice! Fine. I am going to try to be calm too. Give me a second.
Yep, fair, yep! Yep. That is one thing we agree on.
I could come back with something clever. I have got one. I will save it.
One fall, go! Keep me down and I will be amazed. Properly amazed.
On the mat I will go fast and then slow down. Sort of.
Grounded or standing, I am still bouncing. Sorry.
Stay in front of me, and let us see what happens.
Good answer, kind of. I liked that. Really.
Still waiting, come on. Go on, you can do it.
Yep, fair, yep! Got it. Right.
Noted, got it! Bell time, see you!
I will give this match everything, and I will keep my head on while I do it.
My plan is one good idea. Be exciting, be safe, and remember to breathe.
Whatever happens, I want you to know I had a good time.
This is not over. I have got one more idea. It is a good one.
I have one more trick, and you will see it when the bell goes. Honest.
Okay, hang on. I haven't actually got an example, have I? Right. Forget that bit.
No, you're right. I can't prove that. I've got something I can try at the bell, though.
Good! Sorted. Now we can get on with the bit we came here for.
Right, leave that there. Let's see what happens when we actually wrestle!
Okay, test it! First bell to last bell. They'll see if my ideas actually work.
Who gets caught out? Who gets back up? There, two things we can find out!
Right! Forget the rumour. What can we actually show them?
A reaction, yes! But what can the wrestling itself establish for the crowd?
Nice! You've got an answer to my {strength}. Right, I've got another idea for when you try it.
You know my {strength}, brilliant! Now try keeping up when I change things halfway through.
Yep! Hang on, I've got ahead of the actual proof. Scrap that bit.
Fair, fair. It's an idea until somebody actually does it. Got it.
Years! Lots of them. But wait, what about this thing I've been practising?
Okay, so you've done more of this. That doesn't mean you've done this exact bit with me.
Experience. Right. I've learned to stop and pick the useful idea instead of the exciting one. Usually.
I've learned that when plan A goes wrong, I need a plan B, not three more versions of plan A.
